$comment: Where pnpm figma:links points design <-> code links (docs/DESIGN_LINKS.md, Figma dev resources, component documentation links). Component Figma nodes come from each component's @figma JSDoc tag, never from here. storybookUrl: the deployed Storybook root; while null, story links point at the story file on GitHub.

retiredFiles.why: The library before 2026-10-07. Its duplicate 2VgBbVpKiDnu0aftJEVyBQ, formerly the staging copy, became the one library under the same node ids; Adrian renames this file and unpublishes it.

$comment_figmaFiles: ADR-026, amended 2026-10-07. There is one Figma file: libraryFileKey is THE HDS library, and there is no staging file. Agents may write components in it (restyle, add, copy or redraw), but never delete anything in Figma and never publish it: Adrian publishes. Tokens and variables sync straight into it (the Sync plugin and delta.js), which never delete; a deliberate prune is the promote plugin, run by Adrian. retiredFiles are files that must never be linked or written again: check-figma-retired-keys rejects a reference to one in src, public, docs, figma data, mcp, content/docs or the files the package ships from the repo root, and the Sync plugin and every use_figma script (push scripts, snapshot.js, receipt.js, delta.js) refuse them. No carrier an agent runs prunes.
$comment_sync: ADR-032, amended 2026-10-07. pnpm figma:push bakes libraryFileKey, libraryFileName and the retiredFiles keys and names into the Sync plugin (figma/push/plugin), never reading them from the bundle it fetches: it refuses a retired file by key or by name first, then allows the library key, or, where Figma gives no file key, a file marked as the HDS library AND named exactly libraryFileName. It refuses to build while libraryFileKey or libraryFileName is missing or a retired file has the library's key or name.
